overview: You stood in the tiring-house door for The Two Gentlemen of Verona. Kemp's Launce played to an empty rope. No dog came on.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Stood in the door, and did not go on.

parties.name: Will Kemp
parties.context: Played Launce to an empty rope. He was not spoken with.

assets.name: The Two Gentlemen of Verona
assets.disposition: Stood in the door while Launce played to an empty rope

summary: Stood in the door while Launce played to an empty rope
